warehouse-newcastle.title: Distribution Warehouse
warehouse-newcastle.alt: Completed large steel warehouse with multiple roller-door loading bays under a clear sky
warehouse-newcastle.intro: A large-span distribution warehouse for Newcastle — the full structural package fabricated, inspected and shipped door to door from Vietnam.
overview: Distribution warehouses live or die on clear spans and erection speed. For this Newcastle project, the complete structural package — primary frame, secondary steel and connections — was modelled in Tekla by our Ho Chi Minh City drafting office, then fabricated in a Vietnamese factory matched to the project tonnage.
Our own QC inspectors followed the work through the workshop, and the steel was packed, containerised and shipped door to door, arriving on site ready to erect with its full QA documentation pack.
scope: Tekla shop drawings for the full structural package
Primary and secondary steel fabrication
In-process workshop inspection and dimensional checks
Protective packing and optimised container loading
Door-to-door shipping and delivery to the Newcastle site

feedlot-bega.title: Feed Lot
feedlot-bega.alt: Crane lifting a roof truss into place over the steel frame of a large agricultural feed lot building
feedlot-bega.intro: An agricultural feed lot structure for the Bega Valley — connections trial-assembled in the factory so erection on a working rural site went straight up.
overview: Agricultural structures are erected fast, often far from fabrication support — there is no room for connections that do not fit. This feed lot structure for Bega was fabricated in Vietnam with trial assembly of its connections before shipping, proving the fit in the factory rather than on site.
The erected result in the Bega Valley shows the frame standing as modelled: roof trusses lifted straight into place over the completed steelwork.
scope: Structural steel fabrication for the feed lot frame and roof
Trial assembly of connections at the factory
Welding to AS/NZS 1554.1 with qualified welders
Full QA documentation pack
Door-to-door delivery to the Bega Valley site

manufacturing-sa.title: Manufacturing Facility
manufacturing-sa.alt: Two cranes erecting the white steel frame of a manufacturing facility against a blue sky
manufacturing-sa.intro: A heavy industrial frame for a South Australian manufacturing plant — fabricated to AS/NZS standards and delivered ready to erect.
overview: Manufacturing plants carry heavier loads, tighter interfaces with equipment and less tolerance for rework than standard sheds. This South Australian frame was fabricated to AS/NZS standards under our inspection regime, with dimensional and weld visual checks against the Tekla model before dispatch.
Delivered ready to erect, the frame went up under two cranes exactly as drawn — the outcome the inspection process is designed to guarantee.
scope: Heavy industrial frame fabrication
Tekla shop drawings and connection detailing
Dimensional and weld visual inspection reports
Surface treatment inspection before dispatch
Door-to-door delivery, erection-ready

church-esperance.title: Church
church-esperance.alt: A modern A-frame church building with exposed steel trusses and a tall glazed gable
church-esperance.intro: Architectural steel for a community church in Esperance — long spans and exposed structure, fabricated in Vietnam and shipped across the country to WA.
overview: When the structure is the architecture, every member is on display. This Esperance church uses exposed steel trusses and a tall glazed gable, so finish quality and connection detailing mattered as much as strength.
The steel was fabricated and finish-inspected in Vietnam, then shipped across the country to Western Australia — proof that distance is no barrier when the QA system travels with the steel.
scope: Architectural exposed-steel fabrication
Long-span truss fabrication and detailing
Surface and finish inspection
Protective packing for long-distance shipping
Delivery to site in Esperance, WA

warehouse-brisbane.title: Warehouse & Super Awning
warehouse-brisbane.alt: Completed industrial building with loading docks and a covered canopy area
warehouse-brisbane.intro: A Brisbane warehouse with an oversized super awning — one fabrication package, one shipment, one erection program.
overview: Combining the warehouse frame and its oversized super awning into a single fabrication package kept this Brisbane project simple: one Tekla model, one factory, one shipment and one erection program.
Loading docks and the covered canopy area were delivered as part of the same inspected package, with the complete QA documentation set handed over on delivery.
scope: Warehouse frame and super awning in one package
Tekla shop drawings across both structures
Workshop inspection and QA documentation
Single-shipment packing and logistics
Door-to-door delivery to Brisbane

industrial-newcastle.title: Industrial Building
industrial-newcastle.alt: Aerial view of a very large multi-bay industrial steel frame under construction
industrial-newcastle.intro: A multi-bay industrial building in Newcastle at full erection — the repeatable scale our partner factories are set up for, bay after bay.
overview: Large multi-bay industrial buildings reward a fabrication partner set up for repetition: identical bays, modelled once in Tekla and produced consistently across a long run of steel.

This Newcastle building, photographed from the air at full erection, shows that scale — bay after bay standing true, delivered through the same inspected, door-to-door process as every Smart Solutions Australia project.
scope: Multi-bay industrial frame fabrication
Repeatable bay production from a single Tekla model
Staged inspection across the production run
Programmed packing and shipping in erection sequence
Door-to-door delivery to Newcastle
